CustomObject.description: Holds the shared secret the website webhook must present. Deliberately a CUSTOM SETTING rather than Custom Metadata: a custom setting VALUE is data, so the secret is set per-org and never enters source control, whereas a Custom Metadata record would be committed to git. The definition travels; the secret does not. Website Donations phase 1. Visibility is Public because production does not allow Protected outside a managed package; the org setting "Restrict access to custom settings" keeps it readable only by admins and system-mode code (Jason Ott, 2026-11-20).
CustomObject.label: Webhook Config
